create table dbo.factsales
(
    salesid BIGINT,customerid int,productid int,salesdate date,amount decimal(18,2)
    )
    with 
    (
    DISTRIBUTION=hash(customerid),
     clustered columnstore index
    );

SELECT
    t.name AS TableName,
    i.name AS IndexName,
    i.type_desc
FROM sys.tables t
